## File: backend/app/db.py ```python """SQLite access: connections, the ``get_db`` dependency and schema migrations. The application uses the standard library's :mod:`sqlite3` directly. There is no ORM: queries are short and explicit, and every value goes through a ``?`` placeholder so that user input can never change the meaning of a statement. Connections ----------- Endpoints never open connections. They declare a dependency:: @router.get("/things") def list_things(conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db)): rows = conn.execute("SELECT id, name FROM things").fetchall() ``get_db`` hands out a connection whose rows are :class:`sqlite3.Row` objects (columns readable by name, ``row["name"]``) and with foreign keys enforced. The work done during one request is committed when the endpoint returns normally and rolled back if it raises. Migrations ---------- The schema is defined by :data:`MIGRATIONS`, a list of SQL scripts applied in order. The number of scripts already applied is stored in SQLite's ``user_version`` pragma, so :func:`init_db` only runs the new ones. To change the schema, **append** a script; never edit or reorder the existing entries, because databases in use have already run them. """ from __future__ import annotations import sqlite3 import threading from collections.abc import Iterator from datetime import datetime, timezone #: Schema scripts, applied in order. Append only. MIGRATIONS: list[str] = [ # 1: users. ``username`` is unique without regard to case, so "Alice" and # "alice" cannot both register. """ CREATE TABLE users ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE, password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL ); """, # 2: an audit trail of security-relevant events (sign-ins, failed sign-ins). """ CREATE TABLE audit_log ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, event TEXT NOT NULL, detail TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_at TEXT NOT NULL ); CREATE INDEX audit_log_user ON audit_log(user_id, created_at); """, # 3: personal todo lists. """ CREATE TABLE todos ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, title TEXT NOT NULL, done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL ); CREATE INDEX todos_user ON todos(user_id, created_at DESC); """, ] def utc_now() -> str: """The current time in UTC as an ISO 8601 string, e.g. ``2026-11-24T12:00:00+00:00``. All timestamps are stored in this form. Strings in this format sort in the same order as the times they represent, so ``ORDER BY created_at`` works. """ return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds") def connect(path: str) -> sqlite3.Connection: """Open a connection configured the way the application expects. * rows are :class:`sqlite3.Row`, so columns can be read by name; * foreign key constraints are enforced (SQLite leaves them off by default); * ``check_same_thread`` is off because FastAPI may run a request's dependencies and endpoint in different worker threads. Each connection is still used by one request at a time. """ conn = sqlite3.connect(path, check_same_thread=False) conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON") return conn def schema_version(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int: """How many entries of :data:`MIGRATIONS` have been applied to this database.""" return int(conn.execute("PRAGMA user_version").fetchone()[0]) def init_db(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int: """Apply the migrations this database has not run yet; return how many ran. Each script runs in its own transaction together with the update of ``user_version``, so a failing script leaves the database at the previous version instead of half migrated. """ applied = 0 for number, script in enumerate(MIGRATIONS, start=1): if number <= schema_version(conn): continue with conn: conn.executescript(f"BEGIN;\n{script}\nPRAGMA user_version = {number};\nCOMMIT;") applied += 1 return applied class Database: """Owns the database of one application instance. For a file database every request gets its own connection. An in-memory database (``":memory:"``) exists only as long as its connection, so in that case a single shared connection is kept for the life of the application and access to it is serialised with a lock. """ def __init__(self, path: str) -> None: self.path = path self._shared: sqlite3.Connection | None = None self._lock = threading.Lock() if path == ":memory:": self._shared = connect(path) init_db(self._shared) else: with connect(path) as conn: init_db(conn) def connections(self) -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]: """Yield one connection for a request, committing or rolling back afterwards.""" if self._shared is not None: with self._lock: try: yield self._shared self._shared.commit() except BaseException: self._shared.rollback() raise return conn = connect(self.path) try: yield conn conn.commit() except BaseException: conn.rollback() raise finally: conn.close() _database: Database | None = None def configure(database: Database) -> None: """Make ``database`` the one :func:`get_db` hands connections from.""" global _database _database = database def get_db() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]: """FastAPI dependency: a connection for the current request. Usage:: def endpoint(conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db)): ... Raises: RuntimeError: if the application was not created through :func:`app.main.create_app`, which configures the database. """ if _database is None: raise RuntimeError("database not configured: create the app with create_app()") yield from _database.connections() def audit(conn: sqlite3.Connection, event: str, user_id: int | None = None, detail: str = "") -> None: """Record a security-relevant event in ``audit_log``. Use short event names such as ``"login"``, ``"login_failed"`` or ``"register"``. ``detail`` is free text for humans; never put passwords or tokens in it. """ conn.execute( "INSERT INTO audit_log (user_id, event, detail, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)", (user_id, event, detail, utc_now()), ) def row_to_dict(row: sqlite3.Row | None) -> dict[str, object] | None: """Turn a row into a plain dict (or keep ``None``), e.g. to return it as JSON.""" return None if row is None else {key: row[key] for key in row.keys()} ``` ## File: backend/app/routers/auth.py ```python """Authentication endpoints: register, login, and current user.""" from __future__ import annotations import re import sqlite3 from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, status from pydantic import BaseModel, Field from app.config import Settings, get_settings from app.db import get_db, utc_now from app.errors import bad_request, conflict, unauthorized from app.security import ( CurrentUser, create_access_token, get_current_user, hash_password, password_problem, verify_password, ) router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/auth", tags=["auth"]) USERNAME_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{3,32}$") class RegisterRequest(BaseModel): username: str = Field(..., min_length=3, max_length=32) password: str = Field(..., min_length=1) class RegisterResponse(BaseModel): id: int username: str created_at: str class LoginRequest(BaseModel): username: str password: str class LoginResponse(BaseModel): access_token: str token_type: str = "bearer" expires_in: int class MeResponse(BaseModel): id: int username: str @router.post( "/register", response_model=RegisterResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED, summary="Create a new account", ) def register( data: RegisterRequest, conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db), settings: Settings = Depends(get_settings), ) -> RegisterResponse: """Register a new user. Username must be 3-32 characters of letters, digits, underscore or hyphen. Password must meet the policy checked by :func:`app.security.password_problem`. """ username = data.username.strip() password = data.password if not USERNAME_RE.fullmatch(username): raise bad_request( "invalid_username", "Username must be 3-32 characters and contain only letters, digits, underscore or hyphen.", ) problem = password_problem(password) if problem is not None: raise bad_request("weak_password", problem) password_hash = hash_password(password) created_at = utc_now() try: cursor = conn.execute( "INSERT INTO users (username, password_hash, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)", (username, password_hash, created_at), ) except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc: raise conflict("username_taken", "This username is already taken.") from exc user_id = cursor.lastrowid from app.db import audit audit(conn, "register", user_id, f"username={username}") return RegisterResponse(id=user_id, username=username, created_at=created_at) @router.post("/login", response_model=LoginResponse, summary="Sign in and get an access token") def login( data: LoginRequest, conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db), settings: Settings = Depends(get_settings), ) -> LoginResponse: """Sign in with username and password. Returns an access token on success. Wrong credentials (unknown user or wrong password) both yield the same 401 error to avoid user enumeration. """ username = data.username.strip() password = data.password row = conn.execute( "SELECT id, username, password_hash FROM users WHERE username = ?", (username,) ).fetchone() if row is None or not verify_password(password, row["password_hash"]): from app.db import audit audit(conn, "login_failed", None, f"username={username}") raise unauthorized("invalid_credentials", "Invalid username or password.") user_id = row["id"] from app.db import audit audit(conn, "login", user_id, f"username={username}") token = create_access_token(user_id, row["username"], settings) return LoginResponse(access_token=token, expires_in=settings.token_ttl) @router.get("/me", response_model=MeResponse, summary="Current user") def me(user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user)) -> MeResponse: """Return the signed-in user.""" return MeResponse(id=user.id, username=user.username) ``` ## File: backend/app/routers/todos.py ```python"""Todo endpoints for the signed-in user.""" from __future__ import annotations import sqlite3 from datetime import datetime, timezone from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Query, status from pydantic import BaseModel, Field from app.config import Settings, get_settings from app.db import get_db, utc_now from app.errors import bad_request, not_found from app.pagination import PageParams, page_params, paginate from app.security import CurrentUser, get_current_user router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/todos", tags=["todos"]) class TodoCreate(BaseModel): title: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=200) class TodoUpdate(BaseModel): title: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=200) done: bool | None = None class TodoResponse(BaseModel): id: int title: str done: bool created_at: str updated_at: str def _row_to_todo(row: sqlite3.Row) -> TodoResponse: return TodoResponse( id=row["id"], title=row["title"], done=bool(row["done"]), created_at=row["created_at"], updated_at=row["updated_at"], ) @router.get("", response_model=dict, summary="List todos") def list_todos( done: bool | None = Query(default=None, description="Filter by done status"), page: PageParams = Depends(page_params), user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user), conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db), ) -> dict: """Return the current user's todos, newest first, with pagination. Optional query parameter ``done`` filters by completion status. """ where = "WHERE user_id = ?" params: list[object] = [user.id] if done is not None: where += " AND done = ?" params.append(1 if done else 0) total = conn.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM todos {where}", params).fetchone()[0] rows = conn.execute( f"SELECT id, title, done, created_at, updated_at FROM todos {where} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?", (*params, page.limit, page.offset), ).fetchall() items = [_row_to_todo(row) for row in rows] return paginate(items, total, page) @router.post("", response_model=TodoResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED, summary="Create a todo") def create_todo( data: TodoCreate, user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user), conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db), ) -> TodoResponse: """Create a new todo for the current user.""" title = data.title.strip() now = utc_now() cursor = conn.execute( "INSERT INTO todos (user_id, title, done, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, 0, ?, ?)", (user.id, title, now, now), ) todo_id = cursor.lastrowid row = conn.execute( "SELECT id, title, done, created_at, updated_at FROM todos WHERE id = ?", (todo_id,) ).fetchone() return _row_to_todo(row) @router.get("/{todo_id}", response_model=TodoResponse, summary="Get a todo") def get_todo( todo_id: int, user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user), conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db), ) -> TodoResponse: """Return a single todo belonging to the current user.""" row = conn.execute( "SELECT id, title, done, created_at, updated_at FROM todos WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?", (todo_id, user.id), ).fetchone() if row is None: raise not_found("todo_not_found", f"Todo {todo_id} does not exist.") return _row_to_todo(row) @router.patch("/{todo_id}", response_model=TodoResponse, summary="Update a todo") def update_todo( todo_id: int, data: TodoUpdate, user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user), conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db), ) -> TodoResponse: """Update title and/or done status of a todo.""" row = conn.execute( "SELECT id, title, done, created_at, updated_at FROM todos WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?", (todo_id, user.id), ).fetchone() if row is None: raise not_found("todo_not_found", f"Todo {todo_id} does not exist.") title = data.title.strip() if data.title is not None else row["title"] done = 1 if data.done else 0 if data.done is not None else row["done"] now = utc_now() conn.execute( "UPDATE todos SET title = ?, done = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?", (title, done, now, todo_id), ) row = conn.execute( "SELECT id, title, done, created_at, updated_at FROM todos WHERE id = ?", (todo_id,) ).fetchone() return _row_to_todo(row) @router.delete("/{todo_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT, summary="Delete a todo") def delete_todo( todo_id: int, user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user), conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db), ) -> None: """Delete a todo belonging to the current user.""" cursor = conn.execute( "DELETE FROM todos WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?", (todo_id, user.id) ) if cursor.rowcount == 0: raise not_found("todo_not_found", f"Todo {todo_id} does not exist.") ``` ## File: backend/app/main.py ```python """The application factory. ``uvicorn --factory app.main:build`` serves an application built from environment settings. Tests and scripts call :func:`create_app` with explicit values instead:: app = create_app(db_path=":memory:", secret="test") Adding a feature means writing a router module in :mod:`app.routers` and adding one ``app.include_router(...)`` line below. """ from __future__ import annotations from pathlib import Path from fastapi import FastAPI from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles from app import __version__, errors from app.config import Settings, get_settings, settings_from_env from app.db import Database, configure from app.routers import auth, health, todos FRONTEND_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "frontend" def create_app( settings: Settings | None = None, *, db_path: str | None = None, secret: str | None = None, ) -> FastAPI: """Build a configured application. Args: settings: Complete settings. Read from the environment when omitted. db_path: Shortcut that overrides ``settings.db_path`` (tests use ``":memory:"``). secret: Shortcut that overrides ``settings.secret``. The database is opened and migrated here, so the application is ready to serve requests as soon as this returns. """ if settings is None: settings = Settings(secret=secret or "") if secret is not None else settings_from_env() if db_path is not None or secret is not None: settings = Settings( db_path=db_path or settings.db_path, secret=secret or settings.secret, token_ttl=settings.token_ttl, cors_origins=settings.cors_origins, page_size=settings.page_size, max_page_size=settings.max_page_size, ) settings.validate() app = FastAPI(title="Taskboard", version=__version__) app.dependency_overrides[get_settings] = lambda: settings configure(Database(settings.db_path)) errors.install(app) if settings.cors_origins: app.add_middleware( CORSMiddleware, allow_origins=list(settings.cors_origins), allow_methods=["GET", "POST", "PATCH", "DELETE"], allow_headers=["Authorization", "Content-Type"], ) app.include_router(health.router) app.include_router(auth.router) app.include_router(todos.router) if FRONTEND_DIR.is_dir(): # Mounted last so that /api routes take precedence over static files. app.mount("/", StaticFiles(directory=FRONTEND_DIR, html=True), name="frontend") return app def build() -> FastAPI: """Entry point for ``uvicorn --factory app.main:build``: settings from the environment. A factory instead of a module-level ``app`` means importing this module never needs ``APP_SECRET``, which keeps imports in tests side-effect free. """ return create_app() ``` ## File: frontend/login.html ```html Sign in – Taskboard

const usernameEl = document.getElementById("username"); const signoutBtn = document.getElementById("signout-btn"); const addForm = document.getElementById("add-form"); const todoList = document.getElementById("todo-list"); const pager = document.getElementById("pager"); const prevBtn = document.getElementById("prev-btn"); const nextBtn = document.getElementById("next-btn"); const pageInfo = document.getElementById("page-info"); const filterAllBtn = document.getElementById("filter-all"); const filterOpenBtn = document.getElementById("filter-open"); const filterDoneBtn = document.getElementById("filter-done"); let currentFilter = "all"; // "all", "open", "done" let currentOffset = 0; const PAGE_SIZE = 20; let totalItems = 0; function setActiveFilter(filter) { currentFilter = filter; currentOffset = 0; filterAllBtn.classList.toggle("secondary", filter !== "all"); filterOpenBtn.classList.toggle("secondary", filter !== "open"); filterDoneBtn.classList.toggle("secondary", filter !== "done"); filterAllBtn.disabled = filter === "all"; filterOpenBtn.disabled = filter === "open"; filterDoneBtn.disabled = filter === "done"; loadTodos(); } filterAllBtn.addEventListener("click", () => setActiveFilter("all")); filterOpenBtn.addEventListener("click", () => setActiveFilter("open")); filterDoneBtn.addEventListener("click", () => setActiveFilter("done")); async function loadUser() { try { const user = await apiFetch("/api/auth/me"); usernameEl.textContent = user.username; } catch (error) { // Not signed in or token expired window.location.href = "login.html"; } } function buildQuery() { const params = { limit: PAGE_SIZE, offset: currentOffset }; if (currentFilter === "open") params.done = false; else if (currentFilter === "done") params.done = true; return params; } async function loadTodos() { try { const data = await apiFetch("/api/todos", { query: buildQuery() }); totalItems = data.total; renderTodos(data.items); updatePager(); } catch (error) { showMessage(error.message, "error"); if (error.code === "invalid_token" || error.code === "not_authenticated") { setTimeout(() => window.location.href = "login.html", 1500); } } } function renderTodos(todos) { clear(todoList); if (todos.length === 0) { const empty = el("li", { class: "list-item muted" }, "No todos yet. Add one above!"); todoList.appendChild(empty); return; } for (const todo of todos) { const li = el("li", { class: "list-item" + (todo.done ? " done" : ""), dataset: { id: todo.id } }); const checkbox = el("input", { type: "checkbox", checked: todo.done, "aria-label": "Mark as done" }); checkbox.addEventListener("change", () => toggleDone(todo.id, checkbox.checked)); const titleSpan = el("span", { class: "grow title" }, todo.title); titleSpan.addEventListener("dblclick", () => renameTodo(todo.id, titleSpan)); const renameBtn = el("button", { type: "button", class: "secondary", style: "padding:4px 8px;font-size:0.875rem;" }, "Rename"); renameBtn.addEventListener("click", () => renameTodo(todo.id, titleSpan)); const deleteBtn = el("button", { type: "button", class: "danger", style: "padding:4px 8px;font-size:0.875rem;" }, "Delete"); deleteBtn.addEventListener("click", () => confirmDelete(todo.id, todo.title)); li.append(checkbox, titleSpan, renameBtn, deleteBtn); todoList.appendChild(li); } } function updatePager() { const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalItems / PAGE_SIZE); const currentPage = Math.floor(currentOffset / PAGE_SIZE) + 1; if (totalPages <= 1) { pager.hidden = true; return; } pager.hidden = false; pageInfo.textContent = `Page ${currentPage} of ${totalPages} (${totalItems} total)`; prevBtn.disabled = currentPage === 1; nextBtn.disabled = currentPage === totalPages; } prevBtn.addEventListener("click", () => { currentOffset = Math.max(0, currentOffset - PAGE_SIZE); loadTodos(); }); nextBtn.addEventListener("click", () => { currentOffset += PAGE_SIZE; loadTodos(); }); addForm.addEventListener("submit", async (e) => { e.preventDefault(); await whileBusy(addForm, async () => { const data = formValues(addForm); try { await apiFetch("/api/todos", { method: "POST", body: { title: data.title } }); addForm.reset(); currentOffset = 0; // Show newest first loadTodos(); showMessage("Todo added.", "success"); } catch (error) { showMessage(error.message, "error"); } }); }); async function toggleDone(id, done) { try { await apiFetch(`/api/todos/${id}`, { method: "PATCH", body: { done } }); showMessage(done ? "Marked as done." : "Marked as open.", "success"); loadTodos(); } catch (error) { showMessage(error.message, "error"); loadTodos(); // Revert UI } } function renameTodo(id, titleSpan) { const currentTitle = titleSpan.textContent; const input = el("input", { type: "text", value: currentTitle, style: "flex:1;padding:4px 8px;font:inherit;" }); const saveBtn = el("button", { type: "button", class: "secondary", style: "padding:4px 8px;" }, "Save"); const cancelBtn = el("button", { type: "button", class: "secondary", style: "padding:4px 8px;" }, "Cancel"); const parent = titleSpan.parentElement; const idx = Array.from(parent.children).indexOf(titleSpan); parent.replaceChild(input, titleSpan); parent.insertBefore(saveBtn, parent.children[idx + 1]); parent.insertBefore(cancelBtn, parent.children[idx + 2]); input.focus(); input.select(); function finish() { parent.replaceChild(titleSpan, input); saveBtn.remove(); cancelBtn.remove(); } async function save() { const newTitle = input.value.trim(); if (!newTitle || newTitle === currentTitle) { finish(); return; } if (newTitle.length > 200) { showMessage("Title must be at most 200 characters.", "error"); } finish(); } saveBtn.addEventListener("click", save); cancelBtn.addEventListener("click", finish); input.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") save(); else if (e.key === "Escape") finish(); }); } function confirmDelete(id, title) { if (!confirm(`Delete "${title}"?`)) return; deleteTodo(id); } async function deleteTodo(id) { try { await apiFetch(`/api/todos/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" }); showMessage("Todo deleted.", "success"); loadTodos(); } catch (error) { showMessage(error.message, "error"); } } signoutBtn.addEventListener("click", () => { clearToken(); window.location.href = "login.html";
